# Svelte Animation Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Svelte

## Overview

Creates smooth transitions and animations in Svelte using built-in transition directives, tweened stores, and custom animation functions

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [svelte-animation-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
svelte-animation-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@svelte-animation-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Apply built-in transitions: fade, fly, slide, scale
- Create custom transition functions
- Implement spring and tweened stores for smooth values
- Build crossfade animations with flip technique

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Svelte Transitions**: Built-in transition directives and custom transitions
- **Motion Design**: Spring physics and easing function selection
- **Accessibility**: prefers-reduced-motion respect in animations
